name: ACME FRAUD ANALYTICAL TOOL
description: Analyses customer behaviour with generative AI to flag likely fraudulent activity.
architecture: Scala scoring service with a batch feature store and a GenAI API for narrative explanations.

name: ACME ACTIONS INCOME PROCESSING
description: Batch payroll file that calculates salaries for high-risk public figures.
architecture: Python batch job that reads encrypted input files and writes settlement records.

name: ACME INVEST
description: Cross-asset digital investment platform for professional and institutional clients.
architecture: In-house Linux and Windows services behind an API gateway, with a desktop and web client.

name: ACME DOCUCHAT
description: Vendor SaaS copilot that summarises internal reports and drafts text. Assistive only: a human reviews all output, no untrusted external content is ingested, and it cannot write to systems of record.
architecture: Vendor-hosted SaaS with an embedded frontier-model API.

name: ACME CLIENT INSIGHT COPILOT
description: Vendor SaaS assistant over CRM records and client documents, including files uploaded by clients. Output informs client-facing decisions.
architecture: Vendor-hosted SaaS with RAG over a client document store.

name: ACME MAIL TRIAGE AGENT
description: Vendor agentic AI that ingests inbound external email, classifies and drafts responses, and routes items to internal queues. A human approves every outbound action.
architecture: Vendor-hosted agentic SaaS integrated with the corporate mailbox via API.

name: ACME PAYMENTS AUTOPILOT
description: Vendor agentic AI that validates, repairs and releases payment instructions in the payment hub, with server-side approval gates before any write to the system of record.
architecture: Vendor-hosted agentic SaaS integrated with the payment hub via API and an OAuth service account.

name: ACME SURVEILLANCE SENTINEL
description: Vendor AI that triages trade-surveillance alerts and recommends dispositions. Output can influence regulatory reporting; some dispositions are only partially reversible.
architecture: Vendor-hosted SaaS with embedded GenAI for alert triage and case summarisation.

name: ACME RESEARCH AGENT GATEWAY
description: In-house research RAG and multi-step coding agents for investment pods. Retrieves internal research notes, PM memos, and position context. MCP servers connect to market-data vendors, an OMS read connector, SharePoint, and Git. Untrusted Street research and earnings documents are ingested. Tool grants are per-pod and historically broader than policy. Shadow copies on laptops sit outside this control plane.
architecture: In-house Linux agent runtime with MCP tool servers, a vector store over the research corpus, and mixed frontier/local model backends. Connectors to market-data APIs, OMS, SharePoint, and source control.
